audience: An AI LLM coding agent executing this plan task-by-task, with a human (the repo owner, 'Nathaniel') available at marked decision gates only.
objective: Upgrade the FFL Agent from browser-automation writes and blind research to: (1) a Yahoo Fantasy Sports API client with OAuth2 fspt-w write access replacing the fragile Playwright write path, and (2) a custom Claude connector (remote MCP server) giving the research Routines and the owner's phone live roster/projection/matchup data. Every existing guarantee (guardrails, fallback chain, fail-safe degradation) must survive unchanged.

current_system.summary: A lid-closed MacBook runs launchd->run.sh->set_lineup.py (headless Playwright) Thu 17:30 / Sun 10:30 ET. set_lineup.py: READ (parse Yahoo roster DOM) -> DECIDE (manual lineup.json > fresh Routine advice from advice_remote.json > greedy optimizer) -> WRITE (Yahoo Swap Mode clicks) -> VERIFY (re-parse) -> REPORT (logs/last_status.json + ntfy push; healthchecks dead-man ping in run.sh). Two Claude Code Routines (Thu 20:00 / Sun 13:00 UTC) fire into the persistent operator session, research the slate, and commit advice/lineup.json to main; run.sh extracts it merge-free via git fetch + git show.
current_system.decide_contract: decide(roster) -> (swaps, source, override_skipped); source in {manual, advice, optimizer}; swaps are (out_name, in_name, slot, gain) tuples; build_override_swaps enforces: normalized unique name match, swap-in currently on bench, startable (not BYE and status not in bad_statuses), not locked, slot-eligible, each player in at most one swap, rejected entries reported with reasons.
current_system.report_contract: finish(status, extra, exit_code): status in {SUCCESS, NO_CHANGE, PARTIAL, LOGIN_REQUIRED, ERROR}; exit codes 0/2/3/4; writes logs/last_status.json; ntfy push. DRY_RUN=1 and a PAUSED file both suppress all writes but still report planned swaps.
current_system.test_suite: tests/test_decide.py — 60 browser-free tests; CI (.github/workflows/tests.yml) runs pytest + bash -n on every push. The suite MUST stay green after every task.
known_limitations_this_plan_fixes: Routines cannot see current slot assignments (roster.json lists players, not starters) — advice is framed as start-X-over-Y guesses
roster.json is hand-maintained and drifts after add/drops
Projections come from web search, not Yahoo's own numbers
The Playwright write path depends on 3 unpinned DOM selectors, a persistent cookie profile, a residential IP, and an always-awake lid-closed Mac

research_findings.yahoo_api: Yahoo Fantasy Sports API (fantasysports.yahooapis.com/fantasy/v2) supports OAuth 2.0 with scopes fspt-r (read) and fspt-w (read/write). Write ops: PUT /team/{team_key}/roster with an XML body changes player positions; POST to league transactions does add/drop (FORBIDDEN in this system, see non_negotiables). Developer apps are created free at developer.yahoo.com with Fantasy Sports Read or Read/Write permission. Access tokens expire ~1h; refresh tokens are long-lived (grant_type=refresh_token at https://api.login.yahoo.com/oauth2/get_token).
research_findings.custom_connectors: claude.ai custom connectors are remote MCP servers: publicly reachable HTTPS (Claude connects from Anthropic's cloud), streamable HTTP transport, auth via OAuth (client id/secret under Advanced Settings); a raw bearer-header field is NOT an established UI capability (anthropics/claude-ai-mcp#112), so shared-token servers should accept the token in the URL (`?key=`). Added at Settings -> Connectors -> + -> Add custom connector. Available on the owner's plan.

prior_art.notes: 12 tools (ff_get_leagues/roster/matchup/waiver_wire/build_lineup/refresh_token...); stdio transport for Claude Desktop; Yahoo OAuth via consumer key/secret + helper auth scripts. Reference implementation — CHECK LICENSE before copying code.
Thin MCP front-end for the python yahoo_fantasy_api library.
Fork claiming roster management + waiver functionality.

verified_environment_constraints: The Claude cloud environment's egress proxy blocks arbitrary hosts (ntfy.sh confirmed blocked) — any cloud-side executor idea must first prove healthchecks/ntfy reachability; do not assume it.
Trigger-fired fresh sessions cannot complete git pushes (held for review); Routines therefore fire into the persistent operator session — do not change that without re-validating a smoke push.

non_negotiables: N1: Position swaps only. The API client and MCP server must contain NO code path that calls Yahoo transaction endpoints (add/drop/trade/waiver claims). Unit tests grep BOTH yahoo_api.py and connector/server.py for '/transactions' and fail if present.

N2: Never start BYE/OUT/IR/SUSP players; never move a locked player; min_swap_gain threshold for healthy-starter upgrades; each player in at most one swap. The existing decide()/build_override_swaps logic is the single source of these rules — the API write path consumes its output, never reimplements decision logic.
N3: DRY_RUN=1 and PAUSED must suppress API writes exactly as they suppress browser writes today.

N4: Fail-safe chain preserved: connector down -> Routine falls back to web research + roster.json; advice absent/stale/garbage -> optimizer; API write path failing -> report PARTIAL/error with the same finish() contract (and, during transition, the browser path remains selectable via config).

N5: Secrets (Yahoo client id/secret, access/refresh tokens, connector bearer token) never enter the repository, its history, test fixtures, logs, or last_status.json. Storage: ~/.ffl-secrets/yahoo.json chmod 600 on the Mac; the hosting platform's secret store for the connector.
N6: Every existing test stays green after every task; new behavior ships with new tests; nothing is pushed with a failing suite.
N7: The verify-then-report discipline survives: after any API write, re-read the roster from the API and confirm the change before counting it done.
N8: The MCP server's write tool (ff_set_lineup) ships disabled (ENABLE_WRITES=false), requires an explicit confirm=true argument when enabled, and applies the same N2 validation server-side.

decision_gates.question: Did the fspt-w write proof succeed on the real league? If Yahoo denied Read/Write at app creation or the PUT fails with a scope error, STOP: execute only P3-read-only + P4 (connector without writes) and skip P2/P5.
Two consecutive scheduled game windows completed cleanly on write_path=api? Only then flip the default and schedule browser-path removal.
Choose connector hosting (Fly.io / Render / Cloudflare Workers port) and confirm monthly cost is acceptable before deploy.

Enable ff_set_lineup writes on the connector? Default is read-only forever unless explicitly wanted. WARNING: enabling writes exposes the tool to EVERY session holding the connector — including the research Routines — bypassing the Mac's PAUSED file, the veto window, and executor precedence. If ever enabled: keep confirm=true semantics, and P4.T3's prompt must explicitly forbid Routines from calling it.

phases.name: Yahoo developer app + write proof
phases.goal: Prove, with the owner's real league, that OAuth2 fspt-w lineup writes work — before building anything on the assumption.
phases.blocking: All later phases depend on P0 (P3 read-only tools depend only on P0.T1-T3).

tasks.title: Create the Yahoo developer app
tasks.description: At https://developer.yahoo.com/apps/create/ create an app: API Permissions -> Fantasy Sports -> Read/Write; redirect URI https://localhost:8080 (Yahoo requires https; the code is copied manually from the redirected URL). Record Client ID (Consumer Key) and Client Secret into ~/.ffl-secrets/yahoo.json.
tasks.acceptance: App exists with Fantasy Sports Read/Write listed; if only Read is grantable, record that fact for gate G0.

tasks.title: scripts/yahoo_auth.py — one-time OAuth bootstrap
tasks.description: Authorization-code flow: print the request_auth URL (https://api.login.yahoo.com/oauth2/request_auth?client_id=...&redirect_uri=...&response_type=code), prompt for the pasted code, exchange at https://api.login.yahoo.com/oauth2/get_token, then write access_token/refresh_token/expires_at into ~/.ffl-secrets/yahoo.json (chmod 600). Stdlib urllib only (no new runtime deps for the Mac).
tasks.acceptance: Running it interactively produces a secrets file; a follow-up refresh call (grant_type=refresh_token) returns a new access token.

tasks.title: scripts/yahoo_probe.py — discover team + dump roster payload
tasks.description: GET /users;use_login=1/games;game_keys=nfl/teams?format=json to find team_key; GET /team/{team_key}/roster/players?format=json (and .../players;out=stats for projected points). Print a normalized table: name, selected_position, eligible_positions, status, bye, editability flags, projected points if present. Save ONE sanitized payload (players may keep names; strip all tokens/guids) as a test fixture.
tasks.acceptance: Probe prints the real roster with slot assignments; fixture committed; a NOTES section in the script's output records which fields actually carry: locked/editable state, bye weeks, projected points — these are UNKNOWNS this task exists to resolve.

tasks.title: scripts/yahoo_write_proof.py — supervised benign write + revert
tasks.description: With the human watching: pick two same-position players (one BN, one starter) from the probe, PUT the swapped positions as XML to /team/{team_key}/roster (coverage_type=week, current week), re-GET to confirm, then PUT the original positions back and confirm the revert. Refuse to run within 3h of any lock time.
tasks.acceptance: Both PUTs return 2xx and the re-GETs reflect each state. Record the exact XML shape that worked in docs/api_notes.md (no secrets).

phases.name: Yahoo API client module
phases.goal: A reusable, tested yahoo_api.py that the executor, scripts, and MCP server all share.

tasks.title: yahoo_api.py — token manager + reads
tasks.description: TokenStore(path=~/.ffl-secrets/yahoo.json, env override YAHOO_SECRETS_PATH for the connector): auto-refresh when <60s to expiry, persist rotated tokens, tolerate concurrent refresh with a lockfile. read_roster(week=None) -> list of player dicts in EXACTLY the executor's shape: {name, slot, primary, status, bye, proj, locked} — mapping from the fields P0.T3 verified (slot from selected_position incl. 'W/R/T'/'BN'/'IR'; primary from primary/display position; status from Yahoo status; bye by comparing bye_weeks to current week; proj from projected stats if available ELSE 0.0 with a module-level flag proj_available=False; locked from a per-player editability field IF P0.T3 finds one (Yahoo may expose editability only at roster level) — otherwise default False and rely on per-PUT LockedError mapping plus the N7 verify re-read). Also read_matchup(), read_free_agents(position) for the connector.
tasks.acceptance: Unit tests against the P0.T3 fixture verify every field mapping; test asserts '/transactions' absent from source (N1).

tasks.title: yahoo_api.py — set_positions writer
tasks.description: set_positions(changes: list[(player_key, new_position)], week) builds the exact XML shape recorded in docs/api_notes.md and PUTs it. Error taxonomy mapped to executor semantics: 401 after one refresh attempt -> AuthExpired (executor exit 2 path); per-PUT locked/ineligible errors -> LockedError (skipped reporting; per-swap granularity comes from issuing one PUT per swap, not from Yahoo); HTTP 999/429 -> backoff retry (2s/4s/8s, then fail).
tasks.acceptance: Unit tests cover XML construction, error mapping (mocked HTTP), and the N1 grep test still passes.

tasks.title: Name-to-player_key resolution
tasks.description: The decide() layer speaks player NAMES; the API speaks player_keys. Add resolve(swaps, roster_payload) using the existing norm_name/roster_index functions imported from set_lineup (or moved to a shared module ffl_common.py if circular imports arise) — ambiguity skips, never guesses, consistent with N2.
tasks.acceptance: Tests: exact, normalized, and ambiguous name cases.

phases.name: Executor v2 — API write path
phases.goal: set_lineup.py can run entirely over the API (read + write + verify), selected by config; browser path remains the fallback until gate G1.

tasks.title: config: write_path switch
tasks.description: Add "write_path": "browser" (default). Values: browser | api. CFG.get with 'browser' default so existing configs keep working.
tasks.acceptance: Existing tests green; new test for default.

tasks.title: API read+write+verify branch in set_lineup.py
tasks.description: When write_path=api: READ roster via yahoo_api.read_roster() (no browser launch at all); decide() unchanged; DRY_RUN/PAUSED report planned swaps and exit exactly as today (N3); WRITE via ONE set_positions PUT PER SWAP (two position changes each): Yahoo's roster PUT is atomic per request, so per-swap PUTs are what lets a locked player fail alone while the remaining swaps still land (browser-path parity; a single batched PUT would turn one locked player into all-or-nothing failure); VERIFY by re-reading the roster and confirming every swap landed (N7); report with the same finish() statuses/exit codes, including per-swap skipped reasons for locked/failed entries. AuthExpired maps to LOGIN_REQUIRED/exit 2 with a message pointing at scripts/yahoo_auth.py instead of seed_login.py.
tasks.acceptance: New unit tests for the api branch with a mocked yahoo_api; all prior tests green; pyflakes clean.

tasks.title: run.sh + docs
tasks.description: run.sh needs no functional change (advice fetch, sentinel, healthchecks stay); README gains a 'Write paths' section: browser vs api, the switch, the new LOGIN_REQUIRED meaning per path, and the note that the api path needs no residential IP, no cookie profile, and no DOM pinning.
tasks.acceptance: bash -n clean; README statements match code.

tasks.title: Supervised live API run (lid open)
tasks.description: Human watches: write_path=api, real roster, a real benign swap window. Confirm last_status.json SUCCESS, Yahoo app reflects it, ntfy push arrives.
tasks.acceptance: One clean live api-path run.

tasks.title: Two scheduled windows on api path
tasks.description: Set write_path=api in the Mac's config.json for two consecutive scheduled runs (Thu+Sun). Watch healthchecks + last_status.json.
tasks.acceptance: Two clean windows.

phases.name: Custom Claude connector (remote MCP server)
phases.goal: A hosted streamable-HTTP MCP server wrapping yahoo_api.py, addable at claude.ai Settings -> Connectors -> +.

tasks.title: License check on prior art
tasks.description: Check the LICENSE of derekrbreese/fantasy-football-mcp-public (and any repo whose code is borrowed). If permissive (MIT/Apache), patterns and code may be adapted with attribution; if absent/restrictive, implement clean-room from the Yahoo API docs + our own yahoo_api.py.
tasks.acceptance: License decision recorded in connector/README.md.

tasks.title: connector/ server skeleton
tasks.description: Python MCP SDK (FastMCP), streamable HTTP transport, shared-token auth middleware (env CONNECTOR_TOKEN) accepting BOTH `Authorization: Bearer` and a `?key=` query parameter — the claude.ai Add-custom-connector UI has been reported to expose only OAuth client id/secret under Advanced Settings (anthropics/claude-ai-mcp#112), so the paste-the-full-URL `?key=` form is the claude.ai-compatible path; if neither form works at P4.T1, the fallback task is implementing MCP OAuth. Reuses yahoo_api.py (import path or package the module). Health endpoint for the host's checks.
tasks.acceptance: Local run + MCP inspector (or raw JSON-RPC initialize/tools-list via curl) shows the server and tools.

tasks.title: Read tools
tasks.description: Tools with typed schemas and docstrings written for an LLM consumer: ff_get_roster (live slots + statuses + projections + locked flags), ff_get_matchup (opponent, scores, projections), ff_get_free_agents (position-filtered), ff_get_league_settings. Responses compact JSON; no secrets or tokens ever in outputs.
tasks.acceptance: Each tool returns correct data against the live league in a local test run.

tasks.title: ff_set_lineup (gated write tool)
tasks.description: Input {swaps: [{out, in}], confirm: bool}. Refuses unless ENABLE_WRITES=true env AND confirm=true. Mirrors the executor's validation rules (N2/N8): unique-name match, bench-origin, startable, unlocked, one swap per player; slot-ELIGIBILITY is enforced by Yahoo's own PUT rejection (the league eligibility map isn't in the container) and surfaces through the error path. Applies via set_positions; re-reads to verify; returns applied/skipped-with-reasons.
tasks.acceptance: With ENABLE_WRITES unset, the tool always refuses (test). With it set, a supervised local call applies+verifies a benign swap.

tasks.title: Deploy artifacts
tasks.description: Containerize; document deploy for the G2-chosen host; secrets (Yahoo file contents + CONNECTOR_TOKEN) via the platform secret store, mounted/env-injected, never baked into the image.
tasks.acceptance: Image builds; docs complete.

tasks.title: Deploy + smoke
tasks.description: Deploy to the chosen host; verify public HTTPS reachability and an end-to-end tools/list + ff_get_roster call with the bearer token.
tasks.acceptance: Public URL serving MCP with auth.

Keep the persistent-session delivery model (see verified_environment_constraints).

tasks.title: ROUTINE_PROMPT.md v2
tasks.description: Rewrite inputs: PRIMARY = connector tools (live roster incl. slot assignments — the start-X-over-Y guessing rule is deleted; advice may now reference exact current starters), Yahoo projections, matchup context; SECONDARY = web research for injuries/news/weather; FALLBACK = roster.json + league_settings.json when the connector is unavailable (files stay in the repo, demoted). Advice output contract (advice/lineup.json schema, freshness, commit-to-main) is UNCHANGED so the executor needs no modification. SMOKE MODE trigger becomes 'connector unavailable AND roster.json placeholder'.

tasks.acceptance: Advice commit on main whose entries match live slot reality.

phases.name: Transition and decommission (gated, optional)
phases.goal: Retire the fragile layers the API makes unnecessary — only after G1 proves the api path.

tasks.title: Flip the default write path
tasks.description: write_path default becomes 'api'; browser path stays selectable. seed_login.py/profile/ documented as legacy-fallback-only.
tasks.acceptance: Docs + example config consistent; suite green.

tasks.title: Mac posture decision
tasks.description: The api path needs no browser, no residential IP, no cookie profile — the Mac remains only as the SCHEDULER (launchd) and secrets holder. Options: (a) keep Mac as-is (lowest risk; pmset/launchd unchanged); (b) investigate a cloud executor Routine at lock-minus-40min — ONLY viable if the cloud env's egress proxy permits hc-ping.com/ntfy.sh or an alternative notification path (KNOWN: ntfy.sh is blocked; verify before committing to (b)).
tasks.acceptance: Decision recorded in docs/ENHANCEMENT_PLAN.md.

tasks.title: Retire browser-path code (optional, 4+ weeks after G1)
tasks.description: If the owner chooses: remove Playwright dependency, seed_login.py, DOM-contract code, and the browser branch; simplify tests; update README/teardown. Keep git history as the archive.

risks.risk: Yahoo denies Read/Write permission at app creation
risks.mitigation: Gate G0 catches it in the first hour; plan degrades to read-only connector (research-layer upgrade only), executor keeps the browser path.

risks.risk: Projected points not exposed by the API
risks.mitigation: P0.T3 resolves it empirically; proj falls back to 0.0 which makes the optimizer pass-1-only (safe: it still fixes BYE/OUT), and advice/web research carries projections.

risks.risk: Locked/editability semantics differ from DOM behavior
risks.mitigation: P0.T3 records the real field; P1.T2 maps per-player lock errors to skipped-reporting; N7 verify catches anything that slips.

risks.risk: Yahoo invalidates the refresh token mid-season
risks.mitigation: AuthExpired -> LOGIN_REQUIRED/exit 2 + urgent ntfy, same recovery UX as today (run scripts/yahoo_auth.py once, lid open).

risks.risk: Connector host outage before a lock
risks.mitigation: Routines fall back to web research + roster.json (P4.T3); executor never depends on the connector at all.
N5 + P0.T3 sanitization + a repo-wide secret-pattern grep test added in P1.
Unchanged from current system: consider making the repo private; api path removes the Mac's anonymous-fetch constraint since git fetch can carry a PAT.

workflow: Work on branch claude/yahoo-fantasy-football-system-eyytqg. The Routines commit advice/* directly to main on their own schedule, so the branch and main WILL diverge mid-plan: before every push, git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main into the branch; then push the branch; then update main with git checkout main && git merge <branch> && git push (a merge commit is fine — do NOT rely on --ff-only). The Routines and the Mac read main.
Execute tasks in order; respect depends_on/blocking; STOP at every decision_gate and ask the human.
Before every push: pytest tests/ (all green), pyflakes on changed python, bash -n on changed shell. Never fabricate acceptance — paste real command output when reporting.
Never commit: tokens, client secrets, ~/.ffl-secrets contents, unsanitized API payloads, .env files. Add new runtime state files to .gitignore ROOT-ANCHORED (see .gitignore header comment for why).
Commit style: imperative summary + body explaining WHY; no model names in commits.

Tasks whose ACCEPTANCE needs the owner's Yahoo tokens, league, or account run on the owner's Mac or claude.ai account — P0.T1, the live runs of P0.T2/P0.T3/P0.T4, P2.T4/T5, P3.T3's live check, P3.T6, P4.T1/T4. Author code and exact commands cloud-side, then hand off; never move tokens into the cloud (N5).
If any Yahoo API reality contradicts this plan (field names, XML shape, scope behavior), trust the live API, update docs/api_notes.md, and adjust the plan file in the same commit.
llm_execution_protocol.definition_of_done: G1 passed with write_path=api default (or G0-degraded read-only scope completed); connector live in the owner's Connectors list; both Routines carrying the connector and producing slot-accurate advice; full test suite green; README/ENHANCEMENT_PLAN updated to describe the shipped architecture.
